page.title: 思った内容は、後ろの文で説明

analysis.summaryJa: think/say等の後ろには内容節が続き、thatは案内役として省略可能な場合が多い。過去の報告では基本的な時制の一致を行い、感情形容詞にも内容節を続けられる。
visualEvidence: 導入句から内容場面へ展開する図
過去から過去への時間レール
commonTraps: 内容節の主語動詞を欠く
過去報告で時制関係を無視する
節全体の役割を見失う

questions.prompt: I think ------- the revised route will save us time.

choices.A: that

questions.translationJa: 改訂された経路なら時間を節約できると思います。
questions.explanationJa: thinkの内容をthat節で続けます。

questions.prompt: Ms. Ito said that the meeting ------- canceled because of the storm.

choices.A: is only

questions.translationJa: 伊藤さんは嵐のため会議が中止になったと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去saidに合わせる基本形としてwasを使います。

questions.prompt: We're glad ------- you could join today's workshop.

choices.A: to you

questions.translationJa: 今日の研修に参加していただけてうれしいです。
questions.explanationJa: gladの内容をthat節で説明できます。

questions.prompt: The manager believes ------- the new process is more efficient.

choices.A: to

questions.translationJa: 部長は新しい工程の方が効率的だと考えています。
questions.explanationJa: believesの内容をthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: The supplier told us that the replacement parts ------- ready for shipment.

choices.A: were

questions.translationJa: 仕入先は交換部品が出荷準備済みだと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去toldに対する基本的な時制一致でwereです。

questions.prompt: I hope ------- the client accepts our revised proposal.

choices.A: to client

questions.translationJa: 顧客が改訂提案を受け入れてくれることを願っています。
questions.explanationJa: hopeの内容をthat節で表します。

questions.prompt: The notice stated ------- the west entrance would remain closed until Monday.

choices.A: to

questions.translationJa: 掲示には西入口が月曜日まで閉鎖されたままだと記載されていました。
questions.explanationJa: statedの記載内容をthat節で示します。

questions.prompt: Mr. Cole explained that the error ------- caused by an outdated file.

choices.A: is only

questions.translationJa: コールさんはエラーが古いファイルによって起きたと説明しました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去explainedに合わせる基本形でwas causedです。

questions.prompt: The analyst said that demand ------- during the previous quarter, before her report was issued.

choices.A: had increased

questions.translationJa: 分析担当者は報告より前の四半期に需要が増えていたと述べました。
questions.explanationJa: 報告時よりさらに前の出来事を過去完了で明確にします。

questions.prompt: In conversation, “I think that the plan will work” can often omit -------.

choices.A: plan

questions.translationJa: 会話ではthatを省略できることがよくあります。
questions.explanationJa: think後の目的語的that節ではthatの省略が一般的です。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting a thought.

choices.A: I think the schedule is realistic.
choices.B: I think to the schedule is realistic.
choices.C: I think the schedule realistic is.
choices.D: I think of the schedule is realistic.

questions.translationJa: その日程は現実的だと思います。
questions.explanationJa: the schedule is realistic全体がthinkの内容節です。

questions.prompt: Choose the basic backshifted report.

choices.A: Leo said the train be late.
choices.C: Leo said the train being late.
choices.D: Leo said the train was late.

questions.translationJa: レオは列車が遅れていると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去saidに合わせる基本形としてwasです。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence with an explicit “that.”

choices.A: The report indicates to sales are improving.
choices.B: The report indicates that sales are improving.
choices.C: The report indicates of sales are improving.
choices.D: The report indicates that sales improving.

questions.translationJa: 報告書は売上が改善していることを示しています。
questions.explanationJa: that以下に完全な主語＋動詞の節を置きます。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence after an adjective of feeling.

choices.A: We're pleased you accepted the invitation.
choices.B: We're pleased to you accepted the invitation.
choices.C: We're pleased of you accepted the invitation.

questions.translationJa: 招待を受けていただけてうれしいです。
questions.explanationJa: you accepted...がpleasedの理由・内容を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the correct sentence reporting information.

choices.A: The clerk told me the office close early.
choices.B: The clerk told me that the office closed early.
choices.C: The clerk told me to the office closed early.
choices.D: The clerk told that me office closed.

questions.translationJa: 店員は事務所が早く閉まったと私に伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: told meの後ろにthat節で情報を続けます。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence where “that” can naturally be omitted in ordinary conversation.

choices.A: I believe that the figures are correct.
choices.B: That the figures are correct surprised me.
choices.C: The fact that the figures are correct matters.

questions.translationJa: 数値は正しいと思います。
questions.explanationJa: believeの目的語となるthat節ではthatを省略しやすいです。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence that clearly places an event before a past reporting time.

choices.A: She said the shipment arrives yesterday.
choices.B: She said the shipment will arrive before she spoke.
choices.C: She said the shipment had arrived before noon.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は荷物が正午前に到着していたと言いました。
questions.explanationJa: had arrivedで過去の発言時より前の完了を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the best analysis of “I think the proposal is strong.”

choices.A: proposal alone is the entire content.
choices.B: the proposal is strong is a content clause answering what I think.

questions.translationJa: the proposal is strong全体が『何を思うか』を答える節です。
questions.explanationJa: 節全体がthinkの内容を担います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence with appropriate basic tense alignment in a past report.

choices.A: Yesterday, he said the store was closed.
choices.B: Yesterday, he said the store be closed.
choices.C: Yesterday, he said the store closing.
choices.D: Yesterday, he said to store was closed.

questions.translationJa: 昨日、彼は店が閉まっていると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去saidと内容節wasの基本的な一致です。

questions.prompt: Choose the best sentence if the reported fact is a timeless scientific truth.

choices.A: The teacher said that water boiled at 100°C only because backshift is mandatory.
choices.B: The teacher said that water boils at 100°C.
choices.C: The teacher said water to boil at 100°C.
choices.D: The teacher said that water boiling at 100°C.

questions.translationJa: 先生は水は100℃で沸騰すると言いました。
questions.explanationJa: 普遍的事実は現在も成立するため現在形を保つことがあります。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I think the route is safe.”

choices.A: My thought is that the route is safe.
choices.D: I ask the route to be safe.

questions.translationJa: 私の考えている内容は経路が安全だということです。
questions.explanationJa: 後ろの節がthinkの内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “Mia said that the shop was closed.”

choices.A: Mia closed the shop herself necessarily.
choices.B: Mia reported the information that the shop was closed.
choices.C: The shop said something to Mia.
choices.D: Mia asked the shop to close.

questions.translationJa: ミアは店が閉まっているという情報を伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: that節がsaidの報告内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “I'm glad you came.”

choices.A: I made you come.
choices.B: you came is unrelated to glad.
choices.C: Your coming is the reason/content of my glad feeling.
choices.D: I came because you were glad.

questions.translationJa: あなたが来てくれたことが私のうれしい理由です。
questions.explanationJa: you cameがgladの内容を補います。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “He said the train was late.”

choices.A: He ordered the train to be late.
choices.D: He reported that the train was late.

questions.translationJa: 彼は列車が遅れているという情報を伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 内容節がsaidの報告内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We believe the plan will succeed.”

choices.A: Our belief is that the plan will succeed.
choices.B: We force the plan to succeed.

questions.translationJa: 私たちはその計画が成功すると考えています。
questions.explanationJa: the plan will succeedがbelieveの内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “She said that the package had arrived.”

choices.A: The package arrived after she spoke.
choices.B: She reported an arrival already complete before the relevant past viewpoint.
choices.C: She ordered the package to arrive.

questions.translationJa: 彼女は過去の基準時より前に荷物が到着済みだったと伝えました。
questions.explanationJa: 過去完了が報告時より前の完了を示します。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “The notice says the elevator is unavailable.”

choices.A: The elevator speaks.
choices.C: The content of the notice is that the elevator is unavailable.

questions.translationJa: 掲示が伝える内容はエレベーターが利用できないということです。
questions.explanationJa: 節がsaysの内容です。

questions.prompt: Choose the sentence closest in meaning to: “We're pleased the issue was resolved.”

choices.A: We resolved pleased.
choices.D: The resolution of the issue is the content/reason for our pleased feeling.

questions.translationJa: 問題解決が私たちのうれしい理由です。
questions.explanationJa: 節が感情の内容を説明します。

questions.prompt: Choose the best analysis of “The director said the figures had changed.”

choices.A: had changed can mark a change already occurring before the past reporting viewpoint.
choices.B: figures is the object of changed by director.
